column1: # gather_payload_shrink — RAW measured DEVICE KERNEL DURATION [ns]
# precision contract PINNED and IDENTICAL for every row:
#   dtype bf16 / TILE, gamma bf16 TILE, math_fidelity HiFi2,
# combine topology PINNED FLAT (cw2 == 1) for every row.
# One fresh-cache dispatch per (variant, case). No trial loop.
# ABLATION rows below: output WRONG by design, transport/floor ceilings only.
# GPS_SHRINK=k -> the writer puts tile_bytes/k of each gather tile on the wire.
# GPS_ABLATE=combine -> gather + root fold + multicast removed entirely
# (placement / core count / per-core slice byte-for-byte identical). THE FLOOR.
# ROUND 2 (colpack_regraduate) — fork RE-FORKED from the CURRENT op, which now
# carries Perf-1's phase-4 SFPU rewrite (RsqrtAddUnaryColZero, commit 83e64b50c7).
# Gamma-mcast reuse (commit 80ce979d50) NOT ported: predicate cw==1, never true
# in any row below (every case is W-split). Same box, same precision contract,
# combine topology still PINNED FLAT for every row (see caveat below the table
# for w32x5120/w32x7168/i32x5120/i32x7168, whose real-op default is TWO-STAGE
# since cw = cx*cy > COMBINE_MAX_FLAT_FANIN=24 there — colpack's own precondition
# (not two_stage) means it is INERT on those four in the real op regardless of
# this bench's flat pin; bf16 has no topology dependence so is unaffected).
# One fresh-cache dispatch per (variant, case) except the focus baseline gate.
